description: This SwiftUI view manages user interface for configuring voice wake words, including adding, removing, resetting defaults, and persisting user changes.

classes.name: VoiceWakeWordsSettingsView
classes.description: A SwiftUI View for managing voice wake words configuration.

methods.name: addWord
methods.description: Adds an empty string to the list of trigger words.

methods.name: removeWords
methods.description: Removes trigger words at specified offsets and resets to defaults if list is empty.

methods.name: binding
methods.description: Provides a binding to a specific trigger word at the given index.

methods.name: commitTriggerWords
methods.description: Saves, sanitizes, and synchronizes trigger words with external state.
